product_intent.desired_outcome: A polished booking preview customers can try end to end.
product_intent.name: Studio Flow Booking Preview
product_intent.problem: Clients need an easy way to choose a service and book an appointment.
product_intent.summary: A web application providing a simple service-booking experience for local studio clients, allowing them to browse services, view details, book appointments using an availability calendar, and manage their bookings.
target_users: Local studio clients booking personal-care services

requirements.description: The Home page must display a list of available services that clients can browse. Each service should be selectable to view more details.
requirements.title: Clients can browse selectable services on the Home page.

requirements.description: Upon selecting a service, clients must be directed to a Service Detail page that displays comprehensive information about the chosen service.
requirements.title: Clients can view service details.

requirements.description: The Booking page must include an interactive availability calendar allowing clients to select a date and time for their service.
requirements.title: Clients can book with an availability calendar.

requirements.description: The Booking page must include a form for clients to enter their personal details required for the booking.
requirements.title: Clients can provide customer details for booking.

requirements.description: After successfully booking, clients must be presented with a Confirmation page displaying a clear message that their booking is confirmed.
requirements.title: Clients receive a clear booking confirmation message.

requirements.description: The My Bookings page must display a list of all services the client has booked.
requirements.title: Clients can view a list of their bookings.

requirements.description: The product must not include an admin dashboard.
requirements.title: No admin dashboard.

requirements.description: The product must not include a marketplace feature.
requirements.title: No marketplace.

requirements.description: The product must not include any payment or checkout flow.
requirements.title: No payment or checkout flow.

requirements.description: The product must not include a standalone AI Features page.
requirements.title: No standalone AI Features page.
